items.text: Reducing deadhead miles is our highest company priority right now due to a twenty percent diesel price spike this quarter.
Twelve central dispatchers and eighty-five full-time long-haul drivers across Midwest depots will use the product.
The routing engine must connect to Samsara hardware for telemetry and McLeod LoadMaster for carrier billing.
Pull GPS pings from Samsara REST API every sixty seconds.
Drivers will not have an offline mode in version one.
Cellular connectivity is mandatory for all tablets.
The new dispatch optimizer must go live by a hard cutoff of January 15 before annual carrier contract renewals to avoid penalties with regional shippers.
Email the Samsara API keys and sample webhook payloads.
Export the McLeod LoadMaster data schema and past route logs.
Draft the data ingestion pipeline specification and send it over.

followUps.text: How should the routing engine handle data sync failures when cellular connectivity drops while pulling GPS pings from the Samsara REST API?
followUps.reason: The call confirmed that cellular connectivity is mandatory and there is no offline mode for version one, making the behavior during network drops a critical architectural ambiguity.

followUps.text: What specific operational penalties occur with regional shippers if the dispatch optimizer fails to go live by the January 15 cutoff?
followUps.reason: The meeting established January 15 as a hard deadline tied to annual carrier contract renewals, but the exact impact of missing this date requires clarification.
